seo.title: Pressure Easy — Blood Pressure Tracker for iOS
seo.description: Track blood pressure privately. Log readings, see trends with AHA category indicators, and export PDF reports for your doctor. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: BLOOD PRESSURE TRACKER
hero.title: Track blood pressure, privately.
text: Log readings, see trends, and share reports with your doctor. All your data stays on your device — no accounts, no cloud sync, no subscriptions.

items.title: Blood Pressure Logging
items.text: Log systolic/diastolic readings with pulse. Record your position — sitting, standing, or lying down — and add notes for context.

items.title: Trend Charts
items.text: Visualize your blood pressure over time with beautiful charts. View weekly, monthly, or yearly trends with averages and ranges.

items.title: AHA Category Indicators
items.text: Every reading is classified using American Heart Association guidelines. Color-coded Normal, Elevated, Stage 1, Stage 2, and Crisis levels.

items.title: PDF Export for Doctors
items.text: Generate professional reports with all your readings and statistics. Share via email or print for your next doctor's visit.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: Quick entry from your wrist. Step-by-step logging flow makes it easy to record readings without pulling out your phone.

items.title: HealthKit Sync
items.text: Optionally sync with Apple Health. Read existing data or write new readings. Your health data stays unified in one place.

sections.label: AHA GUIDELINES
sections.title: Understand your numbers.
text: Every reading is automatically classified using American Heart Association guidelines.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your health data stays yours.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Your blood pressure readings are stored locally on your device. We never see them, and neither does anyone else.

cta.title: Start tracking.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
